# Animal models (optional)

Drop these files here and the game picks them up automatically. A species doesn't spawn until its model exists, so no placeholder animals are shown.

| File | Species | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| boar.glb | Cinghiale (hostile) | rigged glTF/GLB; animation clips named idle, walk, run, attack, death (any name containing those words works) |
| chicken.glb | Gallina (passive) | same clip names; idle, walk and run are enough |

Models are scaled to the species height automatically (boar 0.85 m, chicken 0.45 m). Keep them under about 5k triangles each, with textures at 1K or smaller.
